items:
NOTE: I am a SuperHost on AirBnb. We have been renting our home on that platform for several years and we are excited to reach new guests via VRBO.
--------

Slow down, you're here. Hit Reset.

Start your day with coffee on any of the home's 6 balconies. Spend the afternoon on a bike ride, hike through state forests, ride a paddle board on a rare coastal dune lake. Walk barefoot on soft white sand that literally squeaks with each step. Play in the clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Nap on a beach towel. End the day toasting to a perfect sunset. Walk to and enjoy dinner with your loved ones. You might even hear the waves on the way back.
---

Please read the full description of our space before sending a booking request.

Gorgeous, 2500 square foot 5 bedroom/4 bath beach house in Seacrest Beach.

This house is our home. We do live here most of the year but we are happy to share it with you while we are away and trust that you will treat it the way you would want others to treat your home.

We've named our beach house "Reset Button" because life can bring challenges and chaos and we find that when we are here it allows us to- hit reset. We slow down and relax. We clear our minds. We are able to restart/reboot and recalibrate so that we don't forget what is important. We hope that our home does the same for you. Enjoy!

Sleeping capacity-
We indicated an absolute maximum of 15 based on the beds that are furnished with the home. Even though this number of guests can be accommodated we are of the opinion that this would only be recommended for a close, large family used to a "crowded house". And it would only be recommended if at least some of the 15 guests are kids. This is because the top bunks in our bunk rooms are not designed to handle adults.

We have broken down how we arrived at the 15 number in the paragraphs below. In addition, we have uploaded over 100 photos of the property and its surroundings and amenities.

First Floor

Common areas include an entryway, a large well equipped kitchen with counter seating for 4, a large dining area with table/chair/bench seating for up to 10-12.

The living area features a Restoration Hardware down feather filled luxe depth sofa and four club chairs for relaxing and watching a movie. We have Mediacom cable.

There is a deck in the rear with matching outdoor rattan wicker sofas. The backyard is situated along the walking trail and is equipped with a grill for cooking, a picnic table for eating and a seating area with a propane firepit.

On this first level is BEDROOM ONE which includes a king size bed (sleeps 2 max) and a private balcony with a hanging swing and a teak chaise lounger. The bedroom includes a TV.

There is also a full bathroom on the first floor (located next to the bedroom).


Second Floor

This level includes BEDROOM TWO- a well appointed Master Suite with king bed (sleeps 2 max), seating areas and en suite full bath featuring a claw foot bathtub. There is a private balcony with rattan wicker club chairs on one end and a teak chaise lounger and a mini fridge at the other overlooking the greenery of the rear of the home.

At the other end of the second floor are BEDROOM THREE and BEDROOM FOUR--two (mirror image) bunkrooms. These are furnished with a full size bed (bottom) with a twin up top. In addition, below each bunk is an optional twin size trundle that can be pulled out. Each bunkroom sleeps 4 max (Full-2, top bunk-1, lower trundle- 1). Each bunkroom includes a small TV.

Please note: The top bunks are NOT designed to handle adults. BEDROOMS THREE and FOUR are absolutely comfortable for adults but only kids should be on the top bunks. Therefore, the max adults in each of these rooms is 2-3 (if the third adult is ok with sleeping on the bottom trundle and everyone is realistic that the bunkrooms are a tight squeeze for this many big people).

Outside the bunkrooms is a shared balcony with a seating area on one end and a custom built hexagon shaped dining picnic table.

IMPORTANT NOTE: To avoid serious injury or death- none of our guests should ever climb or play on or near balcony railings. Children regardless of age should not be allowed without parental supervision especially on balconies. Respectfully- the furniture in the house (especially on balconies) is not intended to be climbed or played on. We will provide you with information on the area's best playgrounds- many of which are in walking distance.

Back to the Second Floor description.
There is a full bathroom accessed via the hallway next to the bunkrooms.

Finally, nearby is the laundry-- a washer and dryer are in a dedicated area in the second floor hallway.

Third Floor

This level features BEDROOM 5- This space is an open area suite that occupies the entire third story. Please be aware that it does not have a wall or door at the bottom (or top) of the steps leading to it. It is furnished with a full size- aka double- daybed (sleeps max 2) with an optional twin trundle below (sleeps 1). There is a built in media console with a wet bar and a TV. The third story has a full bath.

For anyone working or going to school remotely there is a dedicated office/work area with a desk, chair and a monitor/keyboard/mouse which you are welcome to use. Please bring your own cables (eg. HDMI).

The third floor features two spectacular balconies overlooking the neighborhood. The front balcony features a seating area with 4 club chairs and additional bench seating. The rear balcony features a very large curved sectional. Depending on the size of your party, it is likely that your entire group can fit in this space. It is ideal for morning coffee, watching sunsets, cocktails/socializing or just unwinding.

The house features original artwork by some of our favorite local artists and artisans. We decorated it ourselves for us. We wanted it to feel coastal without being tacky. We believe that just because you are at the beach doesn't mean it should look and feel like you are staying at Sponge Bob's place.

We wanted it to feel sophisticated without being too serious. Swanky but not cheesy. Upscale but also Bohemian. We tried for a mix of stylish and modern combined with classic and timeless. We wanted it to be fun and functional, laid back and a little Zen. We wanted it to flow. We did the best we could with the décor. We love it and we hope you will as well.

After you are booked and prior to check in we will send you a digital Welcome Packet that includes our contact information as well as all the information we can think of to make your stay a big success. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or need anything.

One last thig to manage expectations:

We want you to unpack and settle in and be comfortable during your stay. There are dressers and nightstands and built ins and cabinets and console tables with empty drawers throughout the house that you are welcome to use. And we have provided some options for you to hang your clothing if you wish. BUT... As previously stated- this is our home. We do live here. Out of necessity- we have locked out several closets in the house for the storage of our clothing and personal belongings. So... if you will be bothered that many rooms have the closets locked then Reset Button may not be a good fit for your trip. Please don't book and then punish us with negative feedback later over this matter. We have done our best to make it great for you and to be forthright so that there are no bad surprises. Thanks for your understanding!

Warm regards,

-George, Cal and Cam
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
